description:
Rowan Fitzgerald Auctioneers are delighted to introduce to the market this substantial family home in Ballykeeffe Estate. Having 2 reception rooms are just a key feature of this property that should attract the attention of those looking for a very comfortable family home in a popular residential location. 
Ballykeeffe is a mature, settled location with the majority of residents being long established owner occupiers. A host of sporting and community facilities are catered for in the area including national and secondary schools, Crescent shopping centre, Limerick University Hospital and you are also just a short walk to the local bus service. There are also a host of popular and well-known pubs and restaurants in the surrounding area. 
Accommodation comprises of an entrance hall, family room, living room, open plan kitchen/dining room and utility.  Upstairs there are 3 bedrooms (2 doubles and a single) and main bathroom.

Distance to some key amenities in the area: 
Crescent Shopping Centre 300 mtrs 
Local primary school - 500 mtrs 
Limerick University hospital - 550 mtrs 
Limerick Council offices 600 mtrs 
Local GP surgery 300 mtrs 
Garryowen Rugby Club - 1.1 km 
Crescent College Comprehensive 1.1 km

Viewing this property comes highly recommended as this type of property must be viewed to be fully appreciated.  For more information or to arrange a viewing, please contact Rachael on 061-279423 or email reply to this advert.
